paper_metadata.title: Microstructures and mechanical properties of CrFeNi2Nbx eutectic multicomponent alloys

evidence.quote: The effects of Nb content on microstructures and resultant mechanical properties in Co-free CrFeNi2Nbx (x = 0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.55, 0.6, and 0.8) eutectic multicomponent alloys were investigated at room temperature.

The Nb08 alloy showed a maximum strength that was slightly smaller than that of Nb06; however, early fracture occurred at a strain of 10.4%.

This result can be attributed to the early fracture of Nb08, which appeared to possess a hypereutectic microstructure with the Laves as a primary phase, owing to the high strength but limited ductility of the primary phase.
